Masanet, E., Therkelsen, P. and Worrell, E. (2012). Energy Efficiency Improvement and Cost Saving Opportunities for the Baking Industry: An ENERGY STAR Guide for Plant and Energy Managers. Report LBNL-6112E, Ernest Orlando Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory, Berkeley, CA, December 2012. No DOI or URL printed.

Locators are printed page numbers (PDF page = printed + 5). An ENERGY STAR measure guide for U.S. commercial bakeries (NAICS 311812, 311813, 311821); almost every number is reprinted from other sources. Main file: Tables 3-6 (generic process energy per pound of product, adapted from Sikirica et al. 2003, GRI) and Table 2 (measured at one roll bakery, per pound of DOUGH, Northeast Foods 2012), loaded per process step as technologies (bake step = oven_tunnel-deck; pan washing = cleaning-system; freeze = chiller_freezer; proof, ferment, form-and-chill; motor steps) with steam, fuel and electricity converted from BTU/lb to GJ/t or kWh/t with an explicit formula; the Refrigeration column (typically electricity, p.5) is loaded as electricity; plus one whole-line technology per table (bakery-line_*) with the carrier totals (line electricity = refrigeration + other electricity). Also: burner vs steam-heated oven element efficiencies (Sect. 6.1.4), RF and infrared ovens (description and state only), CHP efficiencies (gas turbine 74% HHV, electrical 27-37%; steam turbine 80% HHV), absorption/adsorption chiller COP 0.68-0.75, PV capex $6-8/W DC and life, case-study plants (Morning Star backpressure turbines, Ghirardelli tri-generation, Kettle Foods PV), HVAC heat-pipe and run-around-loop efficiencies, and Table 7 lamp efficacy (lm/W) and lifetime (h). _measures.csv: quantified measures of Sections 5-6 (savings, costs, paybacks as printed; costs without price year). _other-values.csv: Table 1 economic data, energy shares, ratios, conditions and chart-free statistics. Not loaded: water measures (Sect. 7), energy management (Sect. 3), appendices, Figure 1 (process diagrams), percent-of-total columns.
